sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Time-Definite Small Parcel Courier Operations

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Common Law and Civil Law, with customary law overlay)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus, in force 2020)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] and International Companies (Amendment) Act 2014; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 26 of 2021, as amended; AML/CFT Rules and Prudential Guidelines issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); Proceeds of Crime Act [Cap. 142].

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport for each shareholder, director and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notary public in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Conduct / Police Clearance for each director and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police or competent criminal-records authority in the country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter confirming financial standing and transaction history
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution in the account-holding jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential or business address (utility bill or bank statement)
Corporate due-diligence package for any corporate shareholder (certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles, register of directors, UBO declaration)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or licensed registered agent in the jurisdiction of incorporation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all identifying names, aliases, nationalities and jurisdictions against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Sanctions, UK HMT Sanctions, and Vanuatu's domestic designated-persons list issued by VFSC. Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) required for all foreign and domestic PEPs, their family members, entities owned or controlled by them, and any individual flagged under Interpol notices. Continuous monitoring and transaction screening are required for the Medium_Risk_Enhanced AML/CFT tier.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission e-Registry (VFSC Online Company Registration Portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in Latin script and shall include the suffix 'International Company' or 'IC'/'I.C.' for an International Company. Names in non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into English or French, with a certified translation by a sworn translator filed with the VFSC. Name consistency across all registers and official documentation is mandatory.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a proposed name, the applicant or the licensed registered agent may submit a written administrative appeal to the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of the refusal, stating the grounds of appeal and providing any supporting legal authority or evidence. If the Registrar rejects the appeal or fails to determine it within a reasonable statutory period, the applicant may apply to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu for judicial review in accordance with administrative-law principles.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for statutory purposes: every International Company must maintain a registered office and registered agent in Vanuatu. A virtual office arrangement through a VFSC-licensed registered agent satisfies this obligation. However, for the ISIC 5320 cross-border express courier activity, the separate courier and postal licence regime administered by the Telecommunications, Radiocommunications and Postal Regulator (TRRR) may require a physical local presence, an operational depot, or a designated local authorised agent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-elevated annual likelihood of approximately 35-45% for unannounced physical inspection by VFSC or TRRR, given the medium-risk AML/CFT profile of non-resident-owned International Companies engaged in payment-linked courier operations. The likelihood increases above 50% if the registered office is purely virtual and the activity involves high-volume cross-border parcels.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and initial name-reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation UBO enhanced due diligence, PEP and sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent and independent AML compliance officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for medium-risk International Company incorporations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarisation, certification and consular legalisation of founder documentation set
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notaries public, foreign consulates, and Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs (as applicable)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory consular and notarial tariff (varies by consulate)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office establishment (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent and corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for International Company compliance maintenance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Company incorporation drafting (memorandum and articles) and statutory filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Vanuatu law firm and the VFSC
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Professional fee benchmark for corporate drafting plus VFSC incorporation filing tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Regulatory pre-incorporation brief on the express courier licence (ISIC 5320) and cross-border operational roadmap
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Telecommunications, Radiocommunications and Postal Regulator (TRRR) / Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing advisory market rate for regulated-industry pre-licensing consultations

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [CAP 222], ss. 4-9 (Incorporation), 10 (Memorandum and Articles), 22 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), 73 (Restriction on Domestic Business)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Division, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation issued on filing of the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association with the VFSC Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; share capital may be denominated in any major currency; incorporation may proceed with nil fully paid shares; no escrow account or capital deposit requirement under the International Companies Act [CAP 222]
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: We, the undersigned Subscribers, resolve that: 1. The shares allotted to each Subscriber as recorded in the Share Subscription Statement are hereby confirmed and accepted. 2. The registered office be and is hereby fixed at the office of the Company's licensed Registered Agent, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu. 3. The Registered Agent is instructed to deliver this resolution and the executed Memorandum and Articles to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission forthwith. 4. [Full Name] and [Full Name] be and are hereby appointed first Directors; [Full Name] is appointed Secretary. 5. The Directors are authorized to open bank accounts, engage the tax agent, and perform all ancillary acts to achieve full incorporation and operational mobilization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Division — online Name Reservation Portal, submitted through a licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two to three proposed name options in English or French through the licensed Registered Agent, who files the IC Name Reservation Request with the Examiner of International Names. Upon approval the name is reserved for 30 days pending incorporation. Names that conflict with existing Vanuatu entities or that are prohibited or undesirable under section 8 of the International Companies Act [CAP 222] are rejected.
required_dossiers: IC Name Reservation Request Form
Registered Agent engagement letter
Consent of the Registered Agent
Certificate of good standing for group or parent names, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a proposed name is refused, the alternate names are automatically considered by the Examiner; a written petition may be filed with the Registrar within 14 days, or a fresh naming list may be resubmitted without additional state fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed VFSC Registered Agent / Notary Public in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The subscribers execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association specifying the objects of the company, which include international time-definite small parcel courier operations, the class and amount of share capital, and the currency of the capital account. Signatures are notarized by a Vanuatu notary or, where executed abroad, legalized by apostille. The Registered Agent countersigns the statutory declaration of compliance for filing.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statement of Share Capital and Subscriber Particulars
Consent to Act as Director (two persons)
Consent to Act as Secretary
Statutory declaration of compliance by the Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notarial irregularities are cured by re-execution before a recognized notary; defective capital schedules are amended by a supplementary subscriber resolution executed before submission to the VFSC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing and Payment of Government Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry — Incorporation Filing Window / e-Filing Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registered Agent submits the completed incorporation package to the VFSC International Companies Division, pays the prescribed government filing fee and stamp duty by telegraphic transfer or EFTPOS, and obtains a receipted acknowledgment. The application must conform to sections 4 through 9 of the International Companies Act [CAP 222] and the VFSC filing guidelines.
required_dossiers: Incorporation application on prescribed Form IC-1
Apostille or legalization certificate for foreign-executed signatures
Government fee remittance advice
Registered Agent professional cover letter and checklist
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for insufficiency, the Registered Agent files a written response with supplementary evidence within 14 calendar days; payment discrepancies are cured by re-presentment of the corrected fee and a revised remittance advice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance, Verification, and Posting of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company registration number, legal name, and incorporation date. The Registered Agent verifies the exact legal name against the Certificate, obtains certified copies of the Memorandum and Articles of Association, and files the company record with the appointed bank, tax agent, and relevant licensing authorities.
required_dossiers: Original Certificate of Incorporation
Certified copy of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
VFSC company extract / certificate of good standing
Statement of Registered Office and Registered Agent acknowledgment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Administrative errors in name spelling or capital details on the Certificate are corrected by formal application to the Registrar; certified corrected copies are reissued upon payment of the nominal correction fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Governance, Share Allotment, and Bank Mandate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: First Board of Directors in session, attended by the corporate officer of the Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or pass a written resolution adopting the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution: confirm share allotment, record the adopted registered office, and appoint the first directors and secretary. Thereafter issue share certificates, open the register of members, register of directors, and register of charges, and execute the bank mandate for Credit Card POS and ACH Direct payment rails.
required_dossiers: Adopted Pro-Forma First Board Resolution
Share certificates and statutory registers
Register of directors, secretary, and members
Bank account opening and AML/KYC pack
Registered Agent acknowledgment of office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Defective corporate acts are ratified by a supplementary written board resolution; incomplete bank KYC is cured by submission of refreshed beneficial ownership declarations and source-of-funds evidence.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Ministry of Finance and Economic Management — Department of Treasury Business Licence Office, co-administered with the Port Vila Municipal Council Licensing Inspectorate
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence for International Courier, Storage, and Transport Operations (Class C — Express Delivery and Logistics), issued subject to the Business Licences Act [CAP 243] and, where domestic delivery services are contemplated, a separate domestic trading exemption under section 73 of the International Companies Act [CAP 222]

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Government of Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 — EIA Registration with Preliminary Environmental Report; full EIA Report not triggered for warehousing and light commercial vehicle courier operations absent dangerous-goods or bulk fuel handling
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No uncontrolled wastewater discharge; stormwater retention and oil/grit separation on site; vehicle fleet exhaust consistent with Euro IV-equivalent limits; peak ambient noise not exceeding 65 dBA at the property boundary; solid waste segregated and dispatched only to approved recyclers; no drain discharge of oils, coolants, or degreasing agents

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued by the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services for the sorting depot and office premises; structural load inspection certified by the Port Vila Municipal Building Inspectorate; workplace clearance confirming compliance with the Employment Act [CAP 160] regarding workplace hygiene, manual handling, storage racking, and first-aid provisions

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC) - the revenue department of the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management responsible for the Value Added Tax Act No. 12 of 1998 and the Customs Act [Cap. 246] - is the competent indirect tax authority; public e-services are delivered through the ASYCUDA World customs single-window and the VRC VAT desk in Port Vila. Vanuatu imposes no corporate tax, personal income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax, so no direct-tax administration exists. International Companies (ICs) are registered and supervised by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) under the Financial Services Commission Act No. 14 of 2017; the VFSC portal serves as the company-registration and licensing gateway for offshore entities.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting as the monetary authority and administrator of the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 55], in coordination with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for the licensing of securities, exchange, and money transfer dealers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is freely convertible for current-account transactions, and Vanuatu has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations, meaning no trade-related or invisible-payment restrictions apply to the ISIC 5320 express courier fee stream. Capital-account movements remain subject to procedural exchange control documentation through authorized dealers, but profit remittance and capital repatriation by a tax-exempt International Company are legally permissible without approval bottlenecks; practical friction arises from VUV market thinness, limited correspondent bank routing, and bank-level KYC de-risking, rather than from statutory convertibility barriers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 55], receipts for goods exports must be received through an authorized dealer and repatriated within six months of shipment; for service exports, including cross-border express courier billing, proceeds are treated as invisible transactions and must be repatriated through an authorized dealer without a mandatory statutory conversion ratio. Retained VUV and foreign currency earnings may be held in designated foreign-currency accounts at market rates, subject to the authorized bank's internal documentary review.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (VUV/USD/AUD multi-currency) with segregated Capital Escrow Account if required by onshore lender
Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account for inbound equity injection
Operational Account for corporate treasury and trade settlements
Operational Account for local regulatory and utility payments

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium onshore viability: Vanuatu does not recognize passporting of foreign e-money or EMI licenses; a foreign digital EMI (for example Wise or Airwallex) may be utilized only as an ancillary collection/settlement tool, while primary corporate settlement must flow through a locally licensed authorized dealer. Offshore EMIs facing compliance treatment as unlicensed money transmitters under the Financial Dealers Licensing Act and the Exchange Control framework risk account freezes if used as the dominant clearing rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: There exists no statutory mandate for physical board presence, but tier-1 commercial banks uniformly require either an in-person compliance interview or a live video interview plus notarized verification of each authorised signatory, beneficial owner, and director. Fully remote opening for a Vanuatu International Company is permissible only where the beneficial owner maintains an existing relationship with the bank or a introducer-referral arrangement is in place; first-time non-resident principals should budget for a face-to-face or remote-notary KYC process with apostilled passports and certified corporate registry extracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: International Company with nominee directors and no demonstrable operational substance in Vanuatu
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered agent certificate, VFSC confirmation of good standing, declaration of ultimate beneficial ownership, board resolution appointing operational officers, signed lease or virtual-office service agreement, staff employment contracts or contractor agreements for courier operations, bank-statement trail of the prior six months, and a written substance narrative aligned with ISIC 5320.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Express courier business projected to settle high-velocity cross-border payments with counterparties in multiple unlisted jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: AML/CTF policy manual with transaction monitoring thresholds, OFAC/UN sanctions screening log, due-diligence files on all overseas agent-principals, courier license or membership evidence under the relevant postal/aviation regime, and a jurisdiction-exclusion list evidencing refusal to transact with entities in FATF blacklisted states.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Daily ACH/POS settlements from third-party customer collection points, creating risk of layered or unexplained retail deposits
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master service agreements with each collection agent, detailed settlement reconciliations and retained source-of-funds evidence, per-parcel manifest and waybill records tied to payment rails, audited or management accounts proving business rationale, and internal escalation regime for unusually large or split transactions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection from a non-resident parent routed through multiple intermediate entities or through a private cryptocurrency exchange
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital introduction memorandum, certified board resolution for the share subscription, sworn bank reference letter from the parent institution, intercompany loan or subscription agreement, proof of source of wealth of the ultimate shareholder, and confirmation that the inbound wire is effected directly via SWIFT MT103/MT202 from a VFSC-acceptable jurisdiction.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity is routed by SWIFT MT103 from the parent's prime bank to the Vanuatu International Company's operational account at an authorized dealer (ANZ or BSP). The wire instruction must state purpose code 'Capital contribution under the Memorandum of Association' with the beneficiary's IC registration number; the RBV exchange-control module requires the receiving bank to record the transaction in Form E-Control, alongside a board-approved capital introduction memorandum, a shareholder capital confirmation, and, where the IC uses a capital escrow account, a disbursement undertaking from the independent registered agent.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound courier trade settlements proceed via SWIFT MT103 CHIPS or Fedwire-linked correspondent clearing through ANZ and BSP in USD, AUD, and VUV; VUV domestic clearing runs over the RBV-operated VanClear system. Commercial Letters of Credit are reserved for capital expenditure on aircraft, vehicles, sorting machinery, or principal-agent freight deposits, issued by the authorized dealer with the IC's audited accounts as collateral support; recurring service fees to airline partners, customs brokers, and last-mile agents are executed through standing corporate mandate instructions with trade-purpose codes 'Freight and logistics settlement', subject to the bank's transaction-monitoring documentation retention of manifests and service invoices.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot FX contracts with a licensed authorized dealer in VUV/AUD and VUV/USD for revenue conversion under a demonstrated underlying courier settlement exposure
Forward FX contracts up to 12 months tenor with a licensed Vanuatu authorized dealer, requiring an underlying confirmed invoice or contract and posting of margin
Offshore Non-Delivery Forwards (NDFs) in VUV executed through a VFSC-licensed securities dealer or a qualifying international bank, documented as a hedge of receivable exposure only
Cross-currency swap executed with a VFSC-licensed counterparty and cleared through an authorized dealer, limited to hedging committed capital expenditure or acquisition liability
Natural hedge structures through multi-currency operating accounts (VUV/USD/AUD) that offset courier revenue and settlement costs without entering a derivative instrument

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of the International Company (IC) filed under section 49 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], declaring current registered office, registered agent, directors, members, capital structure, and charges
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Corporate Services Registry, submitted through a VFSC-licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: within 30 calendar days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation; annual recurrent filing each year on the IC's registration anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of USD 50 for each month or part of a month the annual return is overdue, capped at USD 250; if the annual return and fee remain unpaid for six consecutive months after the due date, VFSC may administratively strike the IC off the International Companies Register and dissolve the company; reinstatement requires payment of all arrears and penalties plus a restoration fee of approximately USD 200 and VFSC approval

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. A Vanuatu International Company is statutorily exempt from independent audit and from filing audited financial statements with VFSC, regardless of turnover, total assets, members, or employee count; the exemption applies to the ISIC 5320 cross-border express courier operation unless the company separately holds a VFSC banking, insurance, or financial services licence that imposes prudential audit requirements
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is prescribed for Vanuatu International Companies under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; IFRS is the accepted voluntary standard for any financial statements, management accounts, courier network profit reports, or partner reporting prepared for cross-border lenders, insurers, or acquirers; local Vanuatu GAAP is not separately imposed on ICs

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each annual return to VFSC must restate the current directors and members of the IC; any transfer of shares or change in beneficial ownership during the year must be recorded in the on-site Register of Members and communicated to VFSC through the registered agent within 30 days of the change. Vanuatu maintains a confidential UBO register held by the licensed registered agent at the registered office, subject to lawful VFSC inspection; no separate public UBO annual filing exists, but the registered agent must perform an annual UBO data accuracy confirmation as part of the compliance review preceding the anniversary return. Owing to the Medium_Risk_Enhanced AML tier of the cross-border express courier business and the use of Credit_Card_POS and ACH_Direct payment rails, the annual UBO confirmation is integrated into the agent's customer due diligence refresh and sanction screening cycle.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (shareholders) with full name, address, shareholding, and transfer history
Register of Directors including date of appointment, resignation, and other directorships
Register of Charges (if any encumbrances exist)
Minute Book of general meetings, board meetings, and written resolutions
Confidential UBO register maintained by the licensed registered agent on behalf of the IC

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 650 - USD 1,500 per annum for the licensed registered agent, registered office, corporate secretary, and annual return filing service
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory audit is required; voluntary IFRS-based compiled financial statements or agreed-upon procedures report: USD 1,000 - USD 3,500 per engagement if requested by banks, insurers, or courier network counterparties

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu imposes zero corporation tax, zero personal income tax, zero capital gains tax, zero withholding tax, zero stamp duty and zero estate duty. An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] is statutorily exempt from all present and future Vanuatu taxation pursuant to s.10 of that Act. The only mandatory annual cost is the VFSC licence fee, approximately USD 200–USD 500 depending on registered share capital and payment window. Indirect taxes (15% Value Added Tax and customs duty) apply exclusively to Vanuatu domestic supplies and imports; offshore courier invoicing executed outside Vanuatu does not enter the Vanuatu VAT net.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No income-tax return exists for a Vanuatu International Company. The sole mandatory compliance filing is the annual IC Licence Fee and Confirmation Declaration submitted through the VFSC-licensed registered agent to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) electronic registry; no filing is made to the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual licence fee and confirmation declaration are due on or before 31 January for the renewal period; a staggered anniversary-based billing schedule may be applied by the agent, but the operative VFSC tariff window ends 31 January. Non-payment triggers a 10% late surcharge and, after the statutory cure period, involuntary strike-off from the VFSC register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered name, IC registration number and date of incorporation as stated on the VFSC certificate of incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners must quote the exact certificate name; no Vanuatu tax file number is assigned because the IC is tax-exempt.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 – Registered office and registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Vanuatu registered office address and identity of the VFSC-licensed registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident IC must maintain a registered office through the licensed agent; a PO Box-only address is impermissible and the agent signs the annual confirmation under its own statutory liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration confirming no Vanuatu resident customers, no local business activity, no Vanuatu landholding, and no domestic banking, insurance or trust business
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A cross-border express courier IC must confirm 'no activities in Vanuatu'. Transiting shipments through Vanuatu for non-resident principals is not local trading, but any local pickup, delivery, warehousing or employee engagement with Vanuatu residents invalidates the exemption and triggers business licence and VAT registration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current beneficial-owner particulars maintained by the registered agent under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 5 of 2006
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The ultimate courier business owner, wherever resident, must be identified and updated annually; a bare declaration of nominee shareholders without principal disclosure is a criminal compliance event.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual government fee assessed on the IC's registered share capital and the payment window
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payment received before 31 January is at the standard tariff; post-31 January payment attracts a 10% late surcharge; restoration after strike-off adds restoration fees and attracts enhanced due diligence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual confirmation and fee: automatic 10% surcharge on the government tariff; repeated default: administrative strike-off with immediate loss of legal capacity and account freezing; restoration requires payment of all arrears, surcharges, restoration fees and the removal of adverse flagging; directors who authorise continued trading after strike-off are personally liable for every contract entered into on behalf of the capacity-less company.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu has no statutory dividend withholding tax, and the International Company is expressly exempt from all current and future Vanuatu taxes under s.10 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222]. A foreign parent may repatriate express-courier profits by board resolution with no Vanuatu source taxation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive double tax agreement (DTA) is in force with Vanuatu; the jurisdiction participates only in the OECD Global Forum information-exchange framework and certain tax information exchange agreements. The only relief instrument for an IC is the Certificate of Tax Exemption issued by VFSC on application and annual confirmation; that certificate is presented to foreign banks, customs authorities and counterparties as evidence of non-taxability in Vanuatu. No tax-residency certificate is issued for ICs, and treaty-shopping attempts using a VFSC certificate as a 'TRC' fail immediately and create fraud exposure. The foreign parent must independently apply its home-state CFC, PFIC, foreign-tax-credit and anti-deferral rules to the IC's income.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding: 0% on interest and IP royalties paid by a Vanuatu IC to non-residents. Treaty rate: no DTA in force, therefore no reduced treaty withholding may be invoked. Cross-border royalty and interest receipts into the Vanuatu IC are outside the Vanuatu tax net; the operative tax burden lies solely in the foreign beneficial owner's residence jurisdiction. Payments of lease consideration for aircraft, sorting equipment and courier software to a Vanuatu IC attract no Vanuatu income tax, although physical importation of equipment into Vanuatu triggers customs duty and VAT at the border.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing statute, no Local File, no Master File, and no country-by-country reporting obligation; a VUV threshold is not defined. Prudent foreign parents must nonetheless maintain an OECD-aligned TP benchmarking study for the courier fee flows (typically a TNMM on delivery and sorting functions), because the home tax administration will reattribute profits of the Vanuatu IC under CFC and anti-avoidance rules and will expect arm's-length contemporaneous documentation.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) equivalent to those of BVI, Cayman or Jersey, and a standard IC is subject to no local ESR filing or substance test. Notwithstanding, EU and OECD monitoring of Vanuatu requires demonstrable offshore substance: a real registered office, minute books, signed courier service contracts, actual invoicing and matching bank flows, and board decisions undertaken by non-resident directors. A 'shell' IC with no bank account, no contracts and no transaction records is treated as a conduit or sham by foreign anti-BEPS rules and by Vanuatu AML supervisors, exposing the structure to recharacterisation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: A foreign resident receives express-courier invoicing revenue into the Vanuatu IC's bank account while omitting the underlying profits from the home tax return, or backdated invoices are issued to strip income out of a high-tax jurisdiction into the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu: criminal fraud liability under the Penal Code [Cap 138] with imprisonment exposure; the home tax administration imposes evasion penalties of 50–200% of understated tax plus interest, and courier bank records are obtainable through mutual legal assistance and Global Forum exchange channels.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false invoices or control the Vanuatu IC's bank account face fraudulent-trading liability; civil restitution of all evaded taxes, freezing orders over personal and corporate assets, travel bans, extradition requests and imprisonment in the home jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC signs contracts for local pickup and delivery with Vanuatu residents, leases warehousing in Port Vila, or employs Vanuatu courier and sorting staff without a local business licence, VAT registration and customs declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The IC forfeits its statutory tax exemption retrospectively; the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority assesses 15% VAT on all local supplies together with customs duties; VFSC strikes the company off the register and fines apply under the International Companies Act for each prohibited transaction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the corporation's unpaid VAT, duties and penalties; VFSC disbars the offending directors and agent from forming any future Vanuatu entity, and the directors' personal assets answer for the tax shortfall.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the courier billing platform as a de facto money-service business: collecting cash or card-present payments for third-party invoices, netting or aggregating merchant payments, or moving funds for high-risk shippers without customer due diligence and transaction monitoring.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 5 of 2006: criminal fines and imprisonment of up to 10 years; the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit freezes the IC's accounts; VFSC revokes the IC registration without the usual strike-off cure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Compliance officers, directors and beneficial owners face criminal conviction with automatic confiscation of courier assets; directors of an IC used as a payment façade are personally liable in tort to defrauded third parties and are placed on the national financial exclusion list with travel bans and visa denials.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Beneficial Ownership and Nominee Concealment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing false or incomplete beneficial-owner particulars with the registered agent, or concealing the ultimate profitable owner of the express courier business behind paid nominee shareholders who receive dividends under a silent declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: False statements under the International Companies Act subject the IC to strike-off, regulatory fines and forfeiture of the registered agent's licence; under the AML Act, false CDD information attracts imprisonment and fines in addition to the revocation of the company's exempt certificate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors are criminally liable for the acts of the true principal, and the true beneficial owner, once identified, is personally liable for full restitution; fraudulent nominee structures cause automatic revocation of the exemption certificate and confiscation of dividend flows.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent Tax Residency or Exemption Certificate Claim
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Presenting the VFSC Certificate of Tax Exemption to foreign tax courts, customs authorities or regulators as if it were a tax-residency certificate, or claiming in a CFC/permanent-establishment analysis that the courier business is managed in Vanuatu while board decisions, cash management and courier assets remain in the home country.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC withdraws the certificate and strikes off the IC; the foreign jurisdiction applies CFC, PFIC or exit-tax anti-abuse regimes, reattributes 100% of the courier profits to the beneficial owner and adds civil fraud penalties of up to 100% of the understated tax; professional advisers incur promoter-penalty exposure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who certify offshore management in a tax residency or exemption filing are civilly liable for tax shortfalls, interest and penalties; travel restrictions are routinely imposed in such files and custodial sentences for organised tax fraud reach 7 years in the home jurisdiction.
